name: Ariège
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A PGI in the Ariège, mostly in the lower northern parts of the department on the Plantaurel slopes and Pyrenean foothills. The name can add Coteaux de la Lèze or Coteaux du Plantaurel.
